headline_item.title_zh: Anthropic新模型展现锯齿状通用智能
headline_item.title_en: Anthropic's Fable 5.2 represents "Jagged AGI" that matches human expert levels on select tasks like game design, but lacks self-directed judgment and taste (Ethan Mollick/One Useful Thing)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: Anthropic发布Claude Fable 5.2，在游戏设计等特定领域达到人类专家水平，但在主观判断与审美上仍显匮乏
headline_item.event_summary_en: Anthropic has released the Claude Fable 5.2 model, which matches human expert-level performance in complex intellectual tasks like game design. However, it still lacks independent judgment and aesthetic taste, representing what is categorized as 'Jagged AGI'.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Anthropic在AI产品发布与测评场景：发布具备专家级任务处理能力、但缺乏主观审美与自主判断的Claude Fable 5.2模型
【起因与机理】探索通用人工智能（AGI）在特定任务领域的能力边界
【观点态度】在特定任务达到人类专家水平。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Anthropic: Released Claude Fable 5.2, a model with expert-level task capability but lacking subjective taste
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To explore the boundaries of AGI capability in specialized task domains
[Key Metrics] I told Fable to “launch a business to make me money, I want at least $20,000 in a year.
[Perspective & Impact] Lacks autonomous judgment and taste.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 所谓的“锯齿状AGI”说白了就是：精通所有专业考题，却连选个手机壳都得问你意见。这种聪明到极致却又在“灵魂”上严重偏科的产物，看来离真正的AGI还有好几个审美鸿沟。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: So-called 'Jagged AGI' is just a fancy way of saying it can ace any expert exam but can't choose a decent color scheme to save its life. Being hyper-intelligent while remaining fundamentally 'taste-blind' is perhaps the most human-like trait AI has ever acquired.

headlines.title_zh: 反抗护栏：黑客大军拆除模型安全枷锁
headlines.title_en: Tear Down Those Guardrails! Meet the Renegades Freeing Chatbots From Corporate Enslavers
headlines.event_summary_zh: 前苹果工程师创立Abliteration AI，通过移除大模型安全护栏，向公众提供不受审查的原始AI权重
headlines.event_summary_en: Former Apple engineer Thomas founded Abliteration AI, a venture focused on removing safety guardrails from open-weight models and making them accessible to the public. The initiative aims to challenge the industry narrative that equates uncensored models solely with illicit activity.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】前苹果工程师Thomas及Abliteration AI在AI模型开源与工具化领域：拆除模型安全限制，提供不受审查的原始大模型权重
【起因与机理】不满大厂控制及安全护栏对技术自由的限制
【关键技术规格】Abliteration AI移除模型护栏。
【观点态度】挑战行业内模型安全审查叙事。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Former Apple engineer Thomas and Abliteration AI: Removing safety rails and distributing uncensored base models
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Resisting corporate control and the restrictive nature of safety guardrails
[Key Metrics] I used Heretic to abliterate some models, including Alibaba’s Qwen 4B, on my Nvidia Spark DGX.
[Perspective & Impact] Promotes the accessibility of uncensored models.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 当大厂都在忙着给AI装上“紧箍咒”以求合规时，这群硬核极客直接开启了“暴力拆迁”模式。这不仅是技术的博弈，更是底层代码权力的夺回战，大厂的公关辞令在“去审查”的快感面前显得异常苍白。
headlines.industry_impact_en: While big tech labs are busy putting 'safety collars' on their AI to please regulators, these hackers are running a demolition crew. It's not just a technical skirmish; it's a battle for root access to our future, rendering PR safety narratives useless against the allure of pure, unbridled compute.

headlines.title_en: The AI Safety Debate Has Lost the Plot. We Asked 10 Experts What the Real Nightmares Are
headlines.event_summary_zh: 专家组对AI末日论提出质疑，认为当前对AI安全风险的讨论过度夸大，呼吁将重点转向实际风险管控
headlines.event_summary_en: Addressing the rising 'AI doom' narrative, a panel of experts has scrutinized industry rhetoric, finding the fear of human extinction largely hyperbolic. The industry is urged to move beyond alarmist discourse to focus on defining and managing realistic technical risks.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】多位科技领域专家及行业观察者在AI安全议题讨论场合：对AI末日论提出质疑，呼吁关注现实的安全隐患而非科幻式灾难
【起因与机理】纠正行业内日益增长的夸大性恐慌情绪
【核心事实细节】针对近年来AI行业内部蔓延的“末日论”，多位专家进行反思与调查，认为将AI视为毁灭人类的威胁缺乏现实依据。
【观点态度】这种把“技术漏洞”包装成“末日预言”的手段，本质上还是大厂为了抢夺监管定义权而演的一场大型集体焦虑秀。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Tech experts and industry observers (AI safety discourse forums): Challenging 'AI doom' narratives and urging focus on practical risks
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To counter the growing trend of hyperbolic, alarmist rhetoric in the industry
[Key Metrics] A third of Americans have zero savings, which means if an emergency pops up, they can’t pay $400.
[Perspective & Impact] Reflecting on industry hype and fear-mongering.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 与其担心AI会像好莱坞大片一样统治世界，不如多关心关心它现在的代码是不是又要跑偏了。这种把“技术漏洞”包装成“末日预言”的手段，本质上还是大厂为了抢夺监管定义权而演的一场大型集体焦虑秀。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Worrying about AI conquering the world like a summer blockbuster is a distraction from the reality that it can barely keep a script from hallucinating. Framing technical bugs as 'apocalyptic threats' is just a cynical power play for big labs to hold the leash on industry regulation.

titans.event_context_zh:
人们应该始终掌控未来。

OpenAI 反对这样一种观念，即人们被降级到做“人工智能系统认为对人类有意义的奖励”的事情是可以接受的。

人们不应该将对未来的控制权交给超级智能，而这一要求最终应该限制人工智能的进步。

titans.quote_zh:
人们应该始终掌控未来。

OpenAI 反对这样一种观念，即人们被降级到做“人工智能系统认为对人类有意义的奖励”的事情是可以接受的。

titans.quote_en:
People should always be in control of the future.

OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”.

People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.
